title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入載板支撐、黏著窗口與低損傷解接合。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore carrier support, adhesion window and low-damage release, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與路徑
stages.description: 針對材料與路徑完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for materials and routes, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 載板材料選擇｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對載板材料選擇，把「透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For carrier selection, turn "Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「載板材料選擇」的模型：透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for carrier selection: Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付載板材料選擇的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for carrier selection, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 載板材料選擇：機制
knowledge.text: 透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。
knowledge.textEn: Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 必須排除的錯判：玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「晶圓暫時接合與解接合」的「載板材料選擇｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Carrier selection | mechanism and design” in “Temporary wafer bonding and debonding”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「載板材料選擇」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For carrier selection — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。
玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長
加工時黏得越強解接合一定越好
optionsEn: Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability.
Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength
Assuming stronger process adhesion always improves release
quiz.explanation: 透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。 按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 因此不能採用「玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長」。
quiz.explanationEn: Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability. Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Therefore reject: Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength.

steps.title: 載板材料選擇｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對載板材料選擇，把「透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For carrier selection, turn "Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 將「玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付載板材料選擇的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for carrier selection: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 釋放路徑比較｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對釋放路徑比較，把「熱滑移、UV 與 IR 釋放的作用層和設備邊界不同。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For release-route comparison, turn "Thermal-slide, UV and IR release act at different layers and boundaries." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「釋放路徑比較」的模型：熱滑移、UV 與 IR 釋放的作用層和設備邊界不同。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把吸收層、透明路徑和支撐面標到剖面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for release-route comparison: Thermal-slide, UV and IR release act at different layers and boundaries. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark absorbers, optical paths and supports in section. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 把吸收層、透明路徑和支撐面標到剖面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark absorbers, optical paths and supports in section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：各種解接合只差光源名稱。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating release routes as interchangeable light-source labels. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付釋放路徑比較的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for release-route comparison, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 膠層厚度地圖｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesive thickness map | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對膠層厚度地圖，把「膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For adhesive thickness map, turn "Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 將「總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Challenge the hypothesis "Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付膠層厚度地圖的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for adhesive thickness map: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 膠層厚度地圖：機制
knowledge.text: 膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 必須排除的錯判：總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Misinterpretation to reject: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「膠層厚度地圖」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For adhesive thickness map — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻
厚度減半僅讓剛性減半
分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。
optionsEn: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness
Assuming half thickness means half stiffness
Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately.
quiz.explanation: 膠層厚度變化會轉成加工支撐和厚度誤差。 分開量載板、膠層與晶圓厚度。 因此不能採用「總厚度均勻即可證明膠層均勻」。
quiz.explanationEn: Adhesive variations become support and processing-thickness errors. Measure carrier, adhesive and wafer thickness separately. Therefore reject: Inferring uniform adhesive from uniform total thickness.
